Because the colors alternate, and it must start with a black bar and end with a black bar, the total number n of bars must be odd. For a fixed odd n, the black-white color arrangement has already been completely determined, so it is only necessary to decide which bars have width 2. If there are d bars with width 2 and the remaining bars have width 1, then the total width is n+d=12, so d=12-n. Since d must be between 0 and n, and n is odd, the feasible n are 7, 9, and 11. Count separately: when n=7, d=5, there are C(7,5)=21 kinds; when n=9, d=3, there are C(9,3)=84 kinds; when n=11, d=1, there are C(11,1)=11 kinds. The total number is 21+84+11=116.

method.CoT_raw:
先描述图像：附图中显示的是一个竖直条形码示例，由黑色竖条和白色间隔交替组成；最左边是黑色条，最右边也是黑色条，条的宽度有粗有细。

再推理：题目规定每个条的宽度只能是 1 或 2，总宽度为 12。因为颜色交替，并且必须以黑条开始、以黑条结束，所以条的总数 n 必须是奇数。对于固定的奇数 n，黑白颜色排列已经完全确定，因此只需要决定哪些条宽为 2。

若有 d 个条宽为 2，其余条宽为 1，则总宽度为 n+d=12，所以 d=12-n。由于 d 必须在 0 到 n 之间，且 n 为奇数，可行的 n 是 7、9、11。

分别计数：n=7 时 d=5，有 C(7,5)=21 种；n=9 时 d=3，有 C(9,3)=84 种；n=11 时 d=1，有 C(11,1)=11 种。总数为 21+84+11=116。

method.method_draft: First read the image as showing a left-to-right sequence of alternating vertical black and white strips, with the endpoint color condition matching black at both ends. From the text, each appended strip contributes width 1 or 2, and the total width must be 12. Set up a dynamic program by total width and parity of the number of strips: let O_t be the number of width sequences totaling t with an odd number of strips, and E_t be the number with an even number of strips. Start with E_0=1 and O_0=0. Appending one strip of width 1 or 2 toggles parity, so O_t=E_{t-1}+E_{t-2} and E_t=O_{t-1}+O_{t-2}, with out-of-range terms treated as 0. Compute up to t=12; since starting and ending black requires an odd number of strips, the desired value is O_12=116.
